method: Q4 income is estimated from nine-month run rates; subsequent annual income changes with balances and macro rates. Equity retains earnings after assumed dividends; investments are the balancing asset. Forecasts are estimates, not regulatory capital calculations.
driver_notes: All scenario drivers are analyst estimates, not reported bank guidance. From FY2027, loan and deposit growth = nominal GDP plus spread; operating costs follow CPI; 2026 flows use actual 9M plus estimated Q4. 2026 interest continues actual quarterly run-rate; 2027+ yields adjust by changes in policy and bill rates against 2026 macro, not a direct repricing of the entire book. Investment/cash categories retain a simplified mix and may be infeasible; flags are required. Gross fee income and expense and gross loan allowance are unavailable separately in the interim source. Taxes are held at 35% of positive incremental pre-tax income; NPL is an illustrative scenario and independent of impairment. The 9M equity/CAR ratio calibrates a proxy, not actual regulatory capital; no capital injection or CRR compliance is assumed.
